producer_report.summary: Root cause: the planner brief asked the planner to settle questions and list callers. It never required each claim about existing behavior to cite the function and file:line read, and it never told a revising planner to settle code-named findings by reading. I added CODE_CLAIMS_RULE to the Report of planner_brief, so first-round and revision briefs both carry it. It is prose only: no refusal rule and no prompt change. A new test checks the wording in both brief kinds, the size pin test includes the new rule's length, and CHANGELOG.md has an entry.

22 passed (run before the needle fix; that fix touched only a test string)

criteria_check.criterion: crates/athena-context/src/briefs/planner.rs has a new const (doc comment names the root cause and jobs 20261030-013555-f5qm, 20261031-030119-tw3v, 20261103-075205-wbtm) appended to the Report section of planner_brief. It requires each claim about existing behavior (what consumes a state, which sites produce each error or state class, which input forms an existing rule accepts, which records a gate reconciles, a role or config limit) to name the function and file:line the planner read, and a plan that classifies errors or states to list every producer site with its class.

criteria_check.criterion: The same Report text tells a revising planner to settle each finding that names a file and function by reading that code and citing file:line, rather than leaving it open or answering by assertion; a finding about an unlisted adjacent path (for example the max_concurrency path, role limits, records read from the branch) is answered by listing that path in dependents.
